confidence_notes: Restaurant and beer anchors rest on aggregated cost-of-living and price-index snippets from several sites, some undated, so they are moderately reliable. Cappuccino was not directly sourced: it is inferred from the Americano and street-coffee prices found, plus a small premium for milk-based drinks. Cocktail is based on an Expatistan downtown-club average, raised for tourist-area bars. Wine by the glass is derived from an Expatistan retail bottle price with a restaurant markup. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context; no live booking pages or current listings were inspected. VND figures were converted at roughly 26,000 VND per USD. The FX observation was taken from a search snippet of the RBA page, not from a downloaded RBA data file.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. The basis is Vietnamese coastal tourist cities, with price levels placed below Hanoi, since Numbeo-attributed figures put Da Nang about 9% below Hanoi on a cost-of-living-plus-rent basis. Hostel and hotel tiers follow typical Southeast Asian beach-city tourist pricing.
